editorialPolicy: Updates are selected for buyer relevance. Affiliate status, commission and partner relationships do not influence inclusion or placement.

items.label: Product retirement
items.title: Notion Mail shuts down as Notion shifts email workflows to AI
items.summary: Notion Mail shuts down across all plans on 22 September while Gmail-connected AI features and agent email tools remain available.

items.label: Official product update
items.title: ChatGPT arrives in Microsoft Word across all plans
items.summary: OpenAI has added ChatGPT to Microsoft Word, bringing drafting, summarization, revision and document formatting into the Word sidebar across all ChatGPT plans.

items.label: Official product update
items.title: Zapier lets AI agents build and deploy Zaps through MCP
items.summary: Next Gen Zaps lets supported MCP clients build and deploy Zapier automations from plain-language instructions, currently in early access.

items.label: Official product update
items.title: GitHub Actions adds stronger controls over who can run workflows
items.summary: GitHub Actions workflow execution protections are now generally available, adding workflow-specific targeting, policy insights, REST APIs and safer defaults for public repositories.

items.label: Official product update
items.title: GitHub removes a setup barrier for AI Scan in pull requests
items.summary: GitHub AI Scan can now check pull requests without requiring CodeQL default setup first, reducing configuration friction for eligible GitHub Advanced Security customers.

items.label: Official release
items.title: Notion 3.7 turns team prompts into reusable Agent skills
items.summary: Notion 3.7 adds reusable team skills, a shared skills library and portability to external AI coding agents.

items.label: Official product update
items.title: HubSpot expands its MCP server from insight to action
items.summary: HubSpot is broadening what teams can do with CRM data and actions from AI conversations through its MCP server and Claude connector.

items.label: ToolScout analysis
items.title: September software trends brief
items.summary: A buyer focused look at public product releases and recurring software themes from official vendor sources.
